name: Class C Residence Permit (Students)

requirements.blocker_text: Students intending to attend school in Tanzania apply for a Class C residence permit, the same permit category covering missionaries, researchers, volunteers, and retired persons; documentation requirements vary by sub-category.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Class C residence permit through the Immigration Department with school enrollment documentation.

outcome.duration_length: not specified precisely in the source reviewed; permit issuance/renewal fee is USD 500

sources.title: Embassy of Tanzania, Washington D.C. -- official description of Class C residence permits (students, missionaries, researchers, volunteers, retired persons), USD 500 issuance/renewal fee; dependents (spouse and children under 18) may be endorsed on permits generally

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Tanzania). STATUS: DRAFT -- although the source is tier 1 (an official Tanzanian embassy), it bundles students together with missionaries, researchers, volunteers, and retirees under one Class C category without spelling out student-specific documentation, duration, or any tuition/financial-proof requirement -- marked draft pending a source with student-specific detail (the Immigration Department's own site has dedicated pages but returned only a JavaScript-required placeholder when fetched in this build). family_can_join set true on the general dependents-endorsement note that applies across Class A/B/C, though this was not confirmed specifically for the student sub-category; family_can_work set false since no student-dependent work right was described.
